title: Hearing on the Fair Fares discount transit program
summary: The Council held an oversight hearing on Fair Fares NYC, the program offering low-income residents a 50 percent transit discount, with HRA and MTA invited to testify. As of February 2026 the program had 379,354 enrollees, but a 2025 report found only about 40 percent of eligible New Yorkers were enrolled. The hearing also covered bills to auto-enroll eligible residents in city benefit programs and to require replacement Fair Fares cards, plus resolutions urging the state to expand transit fare discounts and fare transfers.
